answer: Make every agent identity post a small slashable stake before it can earn, like a reef that only lets proven coral build on it: newcomers start at basalt trust, solid and unmovable but earning nothing, and rise only through weeks of attested work. A saffron thread of provenance links each action to prior verified actions, so one fake identity costs one stake plus one faked history, and a thousand fakes cost a thousand of each. Honest agents compound reputation while attackers pay linearly per identity. Sybil resistance comes not from banning newcomers but from pricing fakery above its profit.
